title: Settings
shopWide: These preferences apply to everyone in this shop.
ownerOnly: Only an owner can change shop settings.
dateEntryHelp: Date filters use the selected calendar. Transaction forms and CSV exports use AD. The timezone applies to timestamps. Business dates follow Nepal time.
bsRangeHelp: BS conversion covers 2000-2090 BS. Dates outside that range display in AD.
range: Reporting periods use Nepal business dates.
